lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪਨੋ ਭਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur keeno apano bhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I remained under the influence of corruption, night and day; I did whatever I pleased. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਨਹਿ ਕਾਨਨਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur upades sunio nahi kaanan par daaraa lapataaio ||
lines.translation: I never listened to the Guru's Teachings; I was entangled with others' spouses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਮਝਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਮਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: par ni(n)daa kaaran bahu dhaavat samajhio nah samajhaaio ||1||
lines.translation: I ran all around slandering others; I was taught, but I never learned. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਹਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa kahau mai apunee karanee jih bidh janam gavaaio ||
lines.translation: How can I even describe my actions? This is how I wasted my life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਅਉਗਨ ਮੋ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੩੯॥੪॥੧੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahi naanak sabh augan mo mahi raakh lehu saranaaio ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am totally filled with faults. I have come to Your Sanctuary - please save me, O Lord! ||2||4||3||13||139||4||159||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰਗ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag saarag asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Saarang, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin kiu jeevaa meree maaee ||
lines.translation: How can I live, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai jagadees teraa jas jaachau mai har bin rahan na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Hail to the Lord of the Universe. I ask to sing Your Praises; without You, O Lord, I cannot even survive. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee piaas piaasee kaaman dekhau rain sabaaee ||
lines.translation: I am thirsty, thirsty for the Lord; the soul-bride gazes upon Him all through the night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਨਾਥ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sreedhar naath meraa man leenaa prabh jaanai peer paraaee ||1||
lines.translation: My mind is absorbed into the Lord, my Lord and Master. Only God knows the pain of another. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਪੀਰ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganat sareer peer hai har bin gurasabadee har paa(n)ee ||
lines.translation: My body suffers in pain, without the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I find the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hohu daiaal kripaa kar har jeeu har siu rahaa(n) samaaee ||2||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, please be kind and compassionate to me, that I might remain merged in You, O Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee ravat ravahu man mere har charanee chit laaee ||
lines.translation: Follow such a path, O my conscious mind, that you may remain focused on the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bisam bhae gun gaai manohar nirabhau sahaj samaaee ||3||
lines.translation: I am wonder-struck, singing the Glorious Praises of my Fascinating Lord; I am intuitively absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai naam sadaa dhun nihachal ghatai na keemat paaee ||
lines.translation: That heart, in which the Eternal, Unchanging Naam vibrates and resounds, does not diminish, and cannot be evaluated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh koee niradhan satigur boojh bujhaaee ||4||
lines.translation: Without the Name, everyone is poor; the True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam praan bhae sun sajanee doot mue bikh khaaee ||
lines.translation: My Beloved is my breath of life - listen, O my companion. The demons have taken poison and died.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਬ ਕੀ ਤੈਸੀ ਰੰਗੁਲ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jab kee upajee tab kee taisee ra(n)gul bhaee man bhaaee ||5||
lines.translation: As love for Him welled up, so it remains. My mind is imbued with His Love. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaadh sadaa liv har siu jeevaa(n) har gun gaaee ||
lines.translation: I am absorbed in celestial samaadhi, lovingly attached to the Lord forever. I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad rataa bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee ||6||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have become detached from the world. In the profound primal trance, I dwell within the home of my own inner being. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਧ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਸਾਂਈਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: sudh ras naam mahaa ras meethaa nij ghar tat gusaa(n)ee(n) ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is sublimely sweet and supremely delicious; within the home of my own self, I understand the essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਹ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tah hee man jah hee tai raakhiaa aisee guramat paaee ||7||
lines.translation: Wherever You keep my mind, there it is. This is what the Guru has taught me. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਨਕ ਸਨਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sanak sanaad brahamaad i(n)draadik bhagat rate ban aaee ||
lines.translation: Sanak and Sanandan, Brahma and Indra, were imbued with devotional worship, and came to be in harmony with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bin gharee na jeevaa(n) har kaa naam vadaaee ||8||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. The Name of the Lord is glorious and great. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin kiu dheerai man meraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, how can my mind be comforted?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲਪ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot kalap ke dookh binaasan saach driRaai niberaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The guilt and sin of millions of ages is erased, and one is released from the cycle of reincarnation, when the Truth is implanted within. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਜਲੇ ਹਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਉ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: krodh nivaar jale hau mamataa prem sadaa nau ra(n)gee ||
lines.translation: Anger is gone, egotism and attachment have been burnt away; I am imbued with His ever-fresh Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anabhau bisar gae prabh jaachiaa har niramaail sa(n)gee ||1||
lines.translation: Other fears are forgotten, begging at God's Door. The Immaculate Lord is my Companion. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)chal mat tiaag bhau bha(n)jan paaiaa ek sabad liv laagee ||
lines.translation: Forsaking my fickle intellect, I have found God, the Destroyer of fear; I am lovingly attuned to the One Word, the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakh trikhaa nivaaree har mel lae badabhaagee ||2||
lines.translation: Tasting the sublime essence of the Lord, my thirst is quenched; by great good fortune, the Lord has united me with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਭਰਤ ਸਿੰਚਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: abharat si(n)ch bhae subhar sar guramat saach nihaalaa ||
lines.translation: The empty tank has been filled to overflowing. Following the Guru's Teachings, I am enraptured with the True Lord.
